prerequisites: Apple clang and make already installed
invocation: nstack run P230 media -- ffmpeg ARGS (or ffprobe ARGS)
acceptance: nstack check P230 media: encode, decode, inspect streams, independently compare frame colors and audio onset; change cue frame and rerender

rights: Build only the pinned local-source LGPL configuration. No external codecs, network, models or media are acquired. Preserve source license files and actual -buildconf in the lock.
